newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Maui oil project to boost Fletcher Energy cashflow.
newsitem.headline: Maui oil project to boost Fletcher Energy cashflow.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge chief executive Hugh Fletcher told shareholders on Thursday that its Maui B oil project would produce oil worth NZ$570 million and add $100 million to Fletcher Energy's cashflow this year.
Fletcher paid 69 percent of the $200 million development costs of the Maui B oil project, which is offshore from the west coast of the North Island.
The oil project taps the oil reservoir below the Maui B gas and condensate field.
Fletcher said the oil project will generate cash flow before interest of around $260 million.

"Maui will continue to produce well into the next decade. In addition, there are several promising exploration prospects which could either prolong Maui's life as a gas producer or enable another oil development," he said.
Fletcher said the current focus of Fletcher Energy's operations in Canada was the right to explore 1.2 million acres of land in Alberta.
"This is our current focus, particularly exploring for oil, given the currently high oil prices but low Canadian gas prices," he said. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
